messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

If the MPOO sends the bill for the temporary continuation of the metering point operations to the GO, the GO examines the bill. If the MSPO sends the bill for the temporary continuation of the measurement to the GO, the GO examines the bill. If the MSPO sends the bill for additional readings to the GO, the GO examines the bill. If the MPOO sends the bill for the equipment acquisition to the MPON or the GO, the MPON or the GO examines the bill. The GO or the MPON confirms the invoice with payment advice to the MPOO or the MSPO, or the GO or the MPON rejects the invoice of the MPOO or the MSPO.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="InvoiceExaminationProcess" name="Invoice Examination Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BillTempContinuationMetering" name="MPOO sends bill for temporary continuation of metering point operations">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineBillTempContinuationMetering" name="GO examines the bill">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TempContinuationMetering" name="Process End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_BillTempContinuationMetering" targetRef="Task_ExamineBillTempContinuationMetering" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ExamineBillTempContinuationMetering" targetRef="EndEvent_TempContinuationMetering" />

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BillTempContinuationMeasurement" name="MSPO sends bill for temporary continuation of measurement">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineBillTempContinuationMeasurement" name="GO examines the bill">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TempContinuationMeasurement" name="Process End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="StartEvent_BillTempContinuationMeasurement" targetRef="Task_ExamineBillTempContinuationMeasurement" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ExamineBillTempContinuationMeasurement" targetRef="EndEvent_TempContinuationMeasurement" />

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BillAdditionalReadings" name="MSPO sends bill for additional readings">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineBillAdditionalReadings" name="GO examines the bill">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AdditionalReadings" name="Process End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="StartEvent_BillAdditionalReadings" targetRef="Task_ExamineBillAdditionalReadings" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ExamineBillAdditionalReadings" targetRef="EndEvent_AdditionalReadings" />

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BillEquipmentAcquisition" name="MPOO sends bill for equipment acquisition to MPON or GO">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineBillEquipmentAcquisition" name="MPON or GO examines the bill">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DecisionEquipment" name="Decision on Invoice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm_Equipment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reject_Equipment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmInvoiceEquipment" name="Confirm invoice with payment advice to MPOO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm_Equipment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End_Confirm_Equipment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectInvoiceEquipment" name="Reject invoice of MPOO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reject_Equipment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End_Reject_Equipment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ConfirmEquipment" name="Confirmation Sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End_Confirm_Equipment</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectEquipment" name="Rejection Sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End_Reject_Equipment</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="StartEvent_BillEquipmentAcquisition" targetRef="Task_ExamineBillEquipmentAcquisition" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_ExamineBillEquipmentAcquisition" targetRef="Gateway_DecisionEquipment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_Equipment" sourceRef="Gateway_DecisionEquipment" targetRef="Task_ConfirmInvoiceEquipment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Confirm</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject_Equipment" sourceRef="Gateway_DecisionEquipment" targetRef="Task_RejectInvoiceEquipment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Reject</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End_Confirm_Equipment" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmInvoiceEquipment" targetRef="EndEvent_ConfirmEquipment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End_Reject_Equipment" sourceRef="Task_RejectInvoiceEquipment" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectEquipment" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
